Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillTweak
Description:
Small conveniences in the game's own UI, for FFXIV Korea.

• Filter owned equipment and collectibles, or focus shop lists on collection items.
• Calculate the current shop's currency requirements and shortages, with linked storage records.
• Right-click loot items to view participant choices and publicly received roll results.
• Enable PvP chat bubbles using your game's chat bubble settings.
• Mark positional hits/misses and broken combos on your own damage numbers with game icons and colors.

Open settings: /dbtw or /duckbilltweak. Each feature starts disabled.
Release history: Settings → 업데이트 내역, or /dbtw changelog.

Korean client and Dalamud API 15 only. Loot numbers appear when the game publishes results. Stored inventory records may be incomplete or out of date.
Punchline: Shop collection filters, currency planning and loot results for FFXIV Korea.
Changelog:
• Show positional hits and misses on your damage numbers with an icon and color.
• Optionally mark weaponskills used after a broken combo.
• Settings and features keep working when the Korean Dalamud distribution is rebuilt.
• After a game update, PvP chat bubbles, currency exchange shop tools and the positional/combo display do not work until the plugin is updated for the new game version, with a note in settings.
